# Links in a personal knowledge graph

A link can mean supports, contradicts, illustrates or simply reminds me of. Writing a short reason near the link makes the relationship useful later. A dense visual cluster alone does not establish agreement between its sources.

Keep navigation separate from evidence. A central note may be easy to reach without being the most reliable source. Review orphan notes in context before treating them as a problem; a standalone reference can be intentional. Graph layout is a reading aid, not a proof of intellectual importance.
